paragraphs: EAB sells enrollment marketing, student success technology, data services, and advisory research to schools. It says it works with more than 450 community colleges across the student journey, from recruitment through completion. More than 250 K-12 school districts and independent schools are also named as customers.

On the enrollment side it runs a college search network that uses digital marketing to connect institutions with likely applicants. Financial aid optimization is offered to steer aid dollars toward enrollment and net tuition revenue goals. Navigate360 is the CRM behind recruitment, engagement, and undergraduate enrollment growth. A separate practice covers graduate, online, and adult learner recruitment. For retention, the company sells a platform that helps colleges and universities scale and connect their student success efforts.

The home page says more than 2,100 schools choose EAB. Recruitment marketing alone is credited to over 1,100 schools. Each year, over 95% of enrollment partners choose to continue the relationship, according to the company. EAB says its student success solutions are grounded in insight from more than ten years of research. The company puts its own track record at more than forty years.

quote.text: Are you prepared to build a truly student-centric campus?
